//@version=6
indicator("Consolidation Zones (Range + ATR + optional ADX)", overlay=true, max_boxes_count=200)

// Inputs
lenRange   = input.int(20, "Range Lookback (bars)", minval=5)
rangePctTh = input.float(0.80, "Max Range % of Price", step=0.05)

lenATR     = input.int(14, "ATR Length", minval=1)
atrPctTh   = input.float(0.60, "Max ATR % of Price", step=0.05)

useADX     = input.bool(true, "Use ADX filter?")
lenADX     = input.int(14, "ADX Length", minval=1)
adxMax     = input.float(18.0, "Max ADX", step=0.5)

minBars    = input.int(8, "Min bars to qualify a zone", minval=1)

// Styling
shadeOn    = input.bool(true, "Shade background during consolidation")
boxOn      = input.bool(true, "Draw boxes around zones")
showLabels = input.bool(false, "Show start/end labels")

// Metrics
hh = ta.highest(high, lenRange)
ll = ta.lowest(low,  lenRange)
rangePct = (hh - ll) / close * 100.0

atr = ta.atr(lenATR)
atrPct = atr / close * 100.0

// ADX (compatible): get it from DMI
[plusDI, minusDI, adx] = ta.dmi(lenADX, lenADX)

// Consolidation condition
baseConsol = rangePct <= rangePctTh and atrPct <= atrPctTh 
consol = useADX ? (baseConsol and adx <= adxMax) : baseConsol

// Background shading
bgcolor(shadeOn and consol ? color.new(color.gray, 85) : na)

// Zone tracking + box drawing
var bool inZone = false
var int  zoneStart = na
var float zoneHigh = na
var float zoneLow  = na
var box zoneBox = na

if consol and not inZone
    inZone := true
    zoneStart := bar_index
    zoneHigh := high
    zoneLow  := low
    if boxOn
        zoneBox := box.new(bar_index, high, bar_index, low,
            border_color=color.new(color.gray, 20),
            bgcolor=color.new(color.gray, 88))
    if showLabels
        label.new(bar_index, high, "Consol start",
            style=label.style_label_down, textcolor=color.white, color=color.new(color.gray, 0))

if consol and inZone
    zoneHigh := math.max(zoneHigh, high)
    zoneLow  := math.min(zoneLow,  low)
    if boxOn and not na(zoneBox)
        box.set_right(zoneBox, bar_index)
        box.set_top(zoneBox, zoneHigh)
        box.set_bottom(zoneBox, zoneLow)

if (not consol) and inZone
    zoneBars = bar_index - zoneStart
    if zoneBars < minBars and boxOn and not na(zoneBox)
        box.delete(zoneBox)
    else
        if boxOn and not na(zoneBox)
            box.set_border_color(zoneBox, color.new(#47c447, 0))
            box.set_bgcolor(zoneBox, color.new(color.silver, 88))
        if showLabels
            label.new(bar_index, zoneHigh, "Consol end",
                style=label.style_label_down, textcolor=color.white, color=color.new(color.silver, 0))

    inZone := false
    zoneStart := na
    zoneHigh := na
    zoneLow  := na
    zoneBox := na

// Data window helpers
plot(rangePct, "Range %", display=display.data_window)
plot(atrPct,   "ATR %",   display=display.data_window)
plot(useADX ? adx : na, "ADX", display=display.data_window)

// Alerts
alertcondition(consol and not consol[1], "Consolidation Started", "Consolidation started") 
alertcondition((not consol) and consol[1], "Consolidation Ended", "Consolidation ended")
